Yet Another Gephi Workshop

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

View original embedded media

In my ongoing effort to make sure that everyone in the known world is capable of drawing the most aesthetically pleasing circles with lines connecting them, I’ll be holding another Intro to Gephi workshop at Stanford University in Meyer Library 220 (also known as the Flex Classroom) at 11AM on Friday, November 11th.
